find_nearby_stations.description: List the stations closest to a point, nearest first, with the distance to each and what is standing there. Optionally keep only stations within a radius, or only those with the kind of bike you want.
find_nearby_stations.name: find_nearby_stations

parameters.description: Latitude of the point to search from, in decimal degrees (for example, 46.948 for Bern).
parameters.name: latitude

parameters.description: Longitude of the point to search from, in decimal degrees (for example, 7.447 for Bern).
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.description: Only include results within this many kilometres of the point. Leave blank to search the whole network and rank by distance.
parameters.name: radius_km

parameters.description: Only count vehicles of this kind: 'bike', 'ebike', 'cargo', 'escooter' or 'glider', or one of the network's own type ids, such as 'hbike' for a pedal bike that takes the rider's own battery ('Get availability summary' lists them). Stations with none of the wanted kind are left out.
parameters.name: vehicle_type

parameters.description: Only count e-bikes with at least this much charge left, as a percentage (0 to 100). The network reports the kilometres left rather than a percentage, so the charge is worked out from that against a full battery's range. Pedal bikes never match.
parameters.name: min_battery_level

parameters.description: Leave out stations that are standing empty. Filtering by vehicle type or battery level already implies this.
parameters.name: only_with_vehicles

parameters.description: Return at most this many stations. Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: limit

description: Check live availability across PubliBike Velospot, Switzerland's national bike-sharing network, from the open data it publishes: every station's position, address, network and state; how many bikes, e-bikes, cargo bikes and e-scooters are standing at each, and the range left on every electric one; the nearest station to a point, the nearest bike someone can actually take, or the nearest e-scooter left on the street; and availability totals for a town, a network or the whole country. No account or API key required.
